purpose: Pilot movement evidence and field-review queue. These are scoped observations, not whole-route approvals or a replacement for the source snapshot.
default_profile: ordinary passenger car on a through trip
method: Review official project descriptions and the local OSM snapshot; manual Street View links are navigation aids only. A plan, project-level completion label, or older image does not establish the present movement.

direction_notes.forward: Wood from Augusta to Cortez is southbound-only for motor vehicles in the OSM snapshot. The 1st Ward's CDOT project update specifies this conversion and two-way bicycle access. This is a motor-direction restriction; current physical treatment and installation date are not independently verified.

records.location: Wood Street between Augusta Boulevard and Cortez Street
records.movement: northbound through block / southbound through block
records.source_inference: OSM snapshot indicates northbound blocked by one-way and southbound permitted along this block; bicycle exception does not apply to cars.
records.confidence: moderate for snapshot; current signs unverified
records.effective_period: OSM snapshot 2026-09-11; current ground condition unknown

sources.scope: oneway=yes in southbound node order; oneway:bicycle=no
announces southbound conversion and contraflow bikes from Augusta to Cortez

records.review_needed: Photograph current regulatory signs and both block ends; check temporary changes and approach-to-departure movement.

records.movement: through park between road approaches in either direction
records.source_inference: Snapshot has a destination-only motor segment and cycleway connectors. Neither generic access=yes nor bike continuity establishes general through-car access.
records.confidence: moderate for tagged segment; route correspondence and ground access unresolved
records.review_needed: Map both road ends and park connector; document signs, openings, and any car route along the designated greenway. Destination-only access is not ordinary through access.
